title: The HashiCorp cap JWT validation library before version 0.14.0 is vulnerable to a claims validation bypass that may…
description: The HashiCorp cap JWT validation library versions before 0.14.0 contain a vulnerability that allows bypassing claims validation. This flaw may cause downstream applications to make authorization decisions based on unvalidated claim values. The vulnerability requires attacker-controlled claims in a JWT signed by a trusted key. It is fixed in version 0.14.0.
